title: Digital Foundations — Technology as a Tool for God's Kingdom
description: Test your understanding of technology basics, internet safety, digital citizenship, and Biblical stewardship of technology.

questions.question: According to Exodus 35:31-32, where does the ability to create and build come from?
options: From years of human evolution
From the Spirit of God, who gives wisdom and skill
From trial and error over millions of years
From copying what animals do in nature
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:31-32 says God filled Bezalel with His Spirit, giving him wisdom, understanding, and skill. Our ability to create — including technology — is a gift from God.

questions.question: What is the difference between hardware and software?
options: Hardware is old technology and software is new technology
Hardware is the physical parts of a computer; software is the programs and instructions
Hardware is for gaming and software is for work
There is no real difference between them
questions.explanation: Hardware refers to the physical components you can touch (screen, keyboard, CPU), while software refers to the programs and instructions that tell the hardware what to do.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 4:23 teach us about using the internet?
options: The internet is always safe to use without caution
We should guard our hearts by being careful about what we view and interact with online
We should spend as much time as possible online
The internet did not exist in Bible times so the Bible has nothing to say about it
questions.explanation: Proverbs 4:23 tells us to guard our hearts above all else. This applies to our internet use — we must be careful about the content we consume and the interactions we have online.

questions.question: What is phishing?
options: A type of online game about fishing
A scam that tries to trick people into giving away personal information through fake emails or websites
A method for making computers run faster
A way to organize your digital files
questions.explanation: Phishing is a scam where criminals create fake emails or websites that look legitimate in order to trick people into revealing personal information like passwords or credit card numbers.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:17, how should Christians behave online?
options: However they want, since online actions do not matter
Only posting about church activities
Doing everything — including online activity — in the name of the Lord Jesus
Avoiding the internet entirely
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:17 says whatever we do in word or deed should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus. This includes our online behavior — every post, comment, and interaction.

questions.question: Why is it important to check multiple sources when researching online?
options: Because teachers require it for a grade
Because not all information online is accurate, and comparing sources helps verify the truth
Because it makes your paper longer
Because one source always has all the answers
questions.explanation: Not everything on the internet is true. Checking multiple reliable sources helps you verify information and avoid spreading falsehoods, which is consistent with the Biblical call to pursue truth.

questions.question: What does Biblical stewardship of technology look like?
options: Using technology as much as possible
Never using technology because it is sinful
Managing screen time, caring for devices, and prioritizing real relationships
Only using technology for Bible reading
questions.explanation: Biblical stewardship means responsibly managing what God has given us. For technology, this includes balancing screen time, caring for our devices, and making sure technology does not replace real relationships.

questions.question: What should you do if you witness cyberbullying?
options: Join in so you are not the next target
Ignore it because it is not your problem
Report it to a trusted adult and stand up for the person being bullied
Share it on social media for others to see
questions.explanation: Christians are called to defend the vulnerable and stand up for what is right. If you see cyberbullying, report it to a trusted adult and show kindness to the person being targeted.
